score_observations: Visually inspected score pages 1 and 3: Allegro vivace quarter=132 in 4/4; saxophone rests during opening string exposition.
Page 3 (bars 27 onward) has saxophone sixteenth-note scales, chromatic accidentals, ties and alternating slurred/tongued passages over active string counterpoint.
Score is in concert pitch, so displayed saxophone notes must not be treated as written alto range.

identity: Saxophone Concerto for alto saxophone and string orchestra (2014), Christian Blaha
findings: Composer perusal score confirms July 28 to August 28 2014 composition for Femke Steketee, commissioned by Zeeuws Kamerorkest TY.
Premiere 9 November 2014, St. Jacobskerk Vlissingen, Steketee with TY orchestra, conducted by Blaha.
Three movements: Allegro vivace; Allegretto; Allegro vivace. Duration about 19 minutes.
Scoring is alto saxophone plus violin I, violin II, viola, cello, double bass. Donemus D20150 edition copyright 2020 is distinct from 2014 composition.
Composer links a YouTube performance and a full 36-page public perusal score.
